conditions.today: Today will provide the first hints at a shifting weather pattern as a much needed cold front approaches Wyoming from the North. You can expect increasing cloud cover after lunch accompanied by increasing winds. A few showers are possible after the noon hour, but most precipitation is expected to fall tonight. Temps will stay mild during operating hours but the rain snow line is expected to fall overnight as this low pressure system bears down on us. Keep those fingers crossed for a healthy refresh on our beloved slopes. -OH
conditions.yesterday: Sunday shall live up to its' name today as clear and warming conditions continue throughout the Teton area. Look for periods of brief cloud cover mixed with sunny skies today. Mid-day temperatures will reach the low 40's at the summit station, while the Village climbs into the low 60's by early afternoon. Moderate, gusty winds will be trending out of the West at 20-27 MPH with afternoon ridgetop gusts ranging from 30-40 MPH. Skiing in Spring is where it's at today. Take your time on the Mountain and let the high elevations revamp your connection to the elements that keep this place special. Sunscreen up and carve it up! -MB
